content.short: Multichain DEX and meta-aggregator focused on better swap execution.
content.description: DackieSwap started as a DEX on newer Layer 2s and now routes trades through a meta-aggregator that compares other aggregators for the best price. The swap screen adds limit orders, a bridge, and GoPlus token risk checks that flag dangerous tokens before you trade. It is built by 404AI Labs and runs on Unichain, World Chain and other networks.
content.meta: Swap through DackieSwap's meta-aggregator with limit orders, bridging and GoPlus risk checks on Unichain and World Chain.
